name: Banana Republic
known_for: Timeless Style for Women and Men

prices.note: Gap Inc. product API that the category page itself calls (commerceProductsSearchUrl in the page source), read with curl and the StylodexBot UA. Women's jeans only (shorts, overalls, skirts, jackets, shirts, pants and capris excluded). Price = the store's regularPrice for colorways not marked down: priceType R, or P (a temporary promotion) without a markdown flag; priceType M and colorways flagged 'price as marked', clearance or final sale excluded. Women's jeans cid=5030, brand=br (22 products, 1 page). 10 styles: High-Rise 90S Straight Jean $120; seven at $130 (The Icon Classic Wide-Leg, High-Rise Kick-Flare, Mid-Rise Barrel Ankle, Ultra High-Rise Flare...); Low-Rise Loose Crop $140; High-Rise Barrel Jean $148. Kept items carried a 'Limited Time Offer' promo flag.
